subject: R Crashes When I Ran Stan Second Time

messages.subject: R Crashes When I Ran Stan Second Time
parts:
Hi, I was able to run the eight schools test example on my Mac. But when I ran the code again, R crashes with the following message below. Am I allowed to run stan twice without getting this error?

> system.time({

+   fit <- stan(model_code = model.code,

+             data = schools.list, 

+             iter = 10000, chains = 4)

+ })


 *** caught segfault ***

 3: getNativeSymbolInfo(name, PACKAGE)

 4: doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler)

13: .local(object, ...)

14: sampling(sm, data, pars, chains, iter, warmup, thin, seed, init,     check_data = TRUE, sample_file = sample_file, diagnostic_file = diagnostic_file,     verbose = verbose, algorithm = match.arg(algorithm), control = control,     check_unknown_args = FALSE, cores = cores, open_progress = open_progress,     ...)

15: sampling(sm, data, pars, chains, iter, warmup, thin, seed, init,     check_data = TRUE, sample_file = sample_file, diagnostic_file = diagnostic_file,     verbose = verbose, algorithm = match.arg(algorithm), control = control,     check_unknown_args = FALSE, cores = cores, open_progress = open_progress,     ...)

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: R Crashes When I Ran Stan Second Time
parts:
On Wednesday, July 29, 2015 at 4:11:36 PM UTC-4, Shyue-Ming Loh wrote:
Hi, I was able to run the eight schools test example on my Mac. But when I ran the code again, R crashes with the following message below. Am I allowed to run stan twice without getting this error?

This is a known issue with 2.7.0 that has been fixed on GitHub and you could install that with

devtools::install_github("stan-dev/rstan", ref = "develop", subdir = "rstan/rstan", dependencies = TRUE)

In general, you can run the same model twice in 2.7.0 as long as you are not doing anything too exotic. Basically, it will be fine as long as you are assigning the result to an object in R's workspace.

Ben
